name: io.github.LightSpeedPlusOne/invovate-mcp-server
description: AI-agent invoice generator: PDF, JSON & UBL in 11 languages via the Invovate API.

environmentVariables.name: INVOVATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free Invovate API key (starts with inv_) from https://invovate.com/auth. Required only for the PDF/UBL tools; calculate_invoice_totals works without it.

environmentVariables.name: INVOVATE_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (defaults to https://invovate.com).
